description: Board declined to compile repeat offender cost data.
Data request deemed too complex and legally problematic.

chips.text: A resident requested data on repeat offenders and associated police costs.
Criminal justice act may prohibit gathering specific individual offender data.

description: SPS units deploy to Firmland Drive, Confederation Mall, 39th Street.

chips.text: Commissioner Santos Ong noted positive community feedback is valuable.
Report details public appreciation received by Saskatoon Police Service.

description: Police and Crisis Teams divert mental health patients from emergency.
Hub helps high-risk families with housing and mental health.
Administration will track unmet demand for Police and Crisis Teams.

chips.text: Commissioner Jeffries moved to track unmet demand for Police and Crisis Team responses.
Taxpayers fund each Police and Crisis Team at roughly $250,000 to $300,000 annually.
The number of calls where PACT teams were needed but unavailable is not currently tracked.
Hub addresses critical needs like housing and basic necessities for vulnerable individuals.

description: Saskatoon Police Service reported only five contact interviews in 2025.
No bias or inappropriate contact found in reviewed interviews.
Board will now receive provincial report on contact interviews.

chips.text: Commissioner Lagimodiere questioned the need for annual report given low usage.
Board discontinued separate annual report, will receive provincial data.
Lack of data on racialized people in contact interviews noted.

description: Board members can attend police governance conference.

chips.text: Conference agenda was not yet available to the Board.
